trigger: The first 48-arm refinement run revealed that equal random seeds on unequal grid shapes did not generate the same initial Fourier realization.
confound: Grid-size comparisons changed both the numerical resolution and the initial condition, so their endpoint differences could not measure grid convergence.
resolution: Generate the seeded realization once on the production N=64 Fourier grid, embed the active shell modes into each refinement grid with discrete-transform normalization, and renormalize to the locked initial kinetic energy.
scope: This amendment changes only refinement initial-condition coupling. It does not change the completed 540-arm production matrix, diagnostics, thresholds, or statistical decision.
falsification_condition: The amended grid comparison is invalid if embedded initial fields disagree on any active Fourier coefficient after transform normalization or if initial kinetic energies differ beyond 1e-12 relative error.
